message.reasoning_content: License worth ~20-60 alashi extra income; rivals have 31.5M and 5.3M cash but their bids hidden. I'm not president (idx0 has influence 3). Bidding high is risky; rivals have more cash. Tie order priority: 1,2,0 — I'm first priority! Bid most of cash? Bid all 17.4M — rivals have 31.5M cash so could outbid. But if they don't value it... License income 20-60 alashi (20-60M units) is huge. Bid max, since tie priority first. But then no cash for later bribes. Given income up to 60M, bidding all 17.4M still profitable. Also shuttle grey goods risk. Let's do bid all-in.
